answer: Cap each quorum at signatures spanning 3 invite-subtrees, so one recruiter's whole branch collapses to a single slot. An honest newcomer earns one zenith under any sponsor and pays nothing extra. A farm that recruits 200 lantern clones from itself buys 1 vote, not 200, because 200 clones collapse to a single quill slot costing 0 credits. The catch is that recruiting from outside becomes valuable, which pays spammers unless the inviter is slashed when a recruit is caught, so the rule must bind the slasher too.
